initial_state.tagline: A simulated pay-later service. Klarna here is invented for this world: every plan, limit, shop and bank account is made up, and no real payment is made.

search_entries.title: Klarna - your purchases and payments (simulated)
search_entries.snippet: Your spending limit, your linked bank account and every plan with its payments and due dates.

search_entries.title: How Klarna works - Pay in 4 and Pay in 30 days
search_entries.snippet: Four equal payments two weeks apart, or one payment 30 days on. The shop is paid in full; a missed payment is retried once before a late fee.

search_entries.title: Link a bank account - Klarna
search_entries.snippet: Payments are taken from the bank account you link: routing number, account number and the name on the account.
